decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 19th March 2007, an erection of a rear roof extension with dormer window including a small extension onto the roof of the rear projection and two roof lights in the front roof plane has the volume of 38.30m3 as shown on drawing number 2006-004 (Rev C), received 28 March 2007, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a rear roof extension with dormer window including a small extension onto the roof of the rear projection and two roof lights in the front roof plane, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informatives:

The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.

The flat roof area to the rear of the roof extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension with dormer window including a small extension onto the roof of the rear projection and two roof lights in the front roof plane
